Apply repeated simultaneous one-cell moves of every movable component until stable (for a component, all destination cells must be empty of other components and not boundary). Preserve zeros and barrier. Demos: bottom wall causes objects downward; left wall causes objects left; right wall causes objects right. Test had top wall; correct output obtained by upward component motion. Important: do not compact each column/row independently; colored objects slide as rigid shapes. In test, components settled as rows: r1: 3 at c0,2,3; 7 c5; 6 c7-9; r2: 3 c0, 8 c1-2, 7 c5,6 c7, 4 c8; r3: 9 c2,3 c4-5,4 c8; r4:9 c2,1 c5-6,5 c7-8. All other cells zero below top border.', path='arc', global_=True); entry
